Oleksandr  Novokhatskyi  
Junior Project Manager | Junior Technical Product Manager  
 Poland   novosaki63@gmail.com        +48532536533|  +380632825243  
  in/oleksandr -novokhatskyi -6253a82b a     github.com/SRXPAN  
 
SUMMARY  
 
Analytical and product -minded professional with a strong technical foundation in Full -Stack and Game Development. Expert in bridging the gap 
between technical feasibility and business value. Proven track record of managing full product lifecycles, building  MVPs from scratch, and 
coordinating cross -functional tasks using Agile methodologies. Passionate about EdTech and AR/VR ecosystems . 
 
EXPERIENCE  
 
Founder  & Product  Lead  
E-learning  Platform  (MVP)
 
October  2025 - March  2026, Radom,  Poland  (Hybrid  / Remote)  
• Product Vision: Personally defined the roadmap and MVP 
scope for a comprehensive web -based learning ecosystem ( e-
learn.space ).  
• Agile Management: Defined release milestones in Jira and 
Confluence, aligning design and development around weekly 
demos to keep the project on schedule.  
• Execution : Implemented a React and Node.js portal with 
gamified progress flows and documented all release criteria to 
guide launch readiness.  
 
Project  Manager  
Indie  Game  Prototype  (Unreal  Engine  5)
 
January  2025 - September  2025, Radom,  Poland  (Hybrid  / Remote)  
• Lifecycle Management: Led the end -to-end development 
cycle of a 3D game prototype, managing scope and Game 
Design Documents (GDD).  
  
 
 
• Team Coordination: Facilitated sprint planning and weekly 
playtest reviews with designers and developers, converting  
findings into prioritized Jira backlog items.  
• Risk Mitigation: Optimized project scope to meet strict 
deadlines, balancing high -quality UI/UX standards with 
technical constraints to prevent "blockers".  
• Workflow: Organized version control (GitHub/Perforce) and 
CI/CD pipelines to streamline asset integration.  
 
Product  Researcher  
AI Automation  & Security  Tools
 
July 2024 - December  2024, Radom,  Poland  (Hybrid  / Remote)  
• Requirements  Gathering:  Conducted  feasibility  analysis  and 
translated  complex  market  needs  into actionable  technical  
requirements.  
• Stakeholder  Alignment:  Developed  user personas,  journey  
maps,  and business  logic for AI-driven  automation  tools. 
• Strategic Reporting: Synthesized interview notes and 
competitor findings into ranked opportunity briefs, giving 
engineering and sales a shared view of feature gaps, 
compliance risks, and launch priorities.
 
 
EDUCATION  
Specialty:  Cybersecurity  
Kyiv National  University  of Economics  (KNEU)  • Kyiv,  Ukraine  • 
06/2022  – Present  
  
Specialty:  Programmer  
University  of Technology  and Humanities  Kazimierz  Pułaski • 
Radom,  Poland  • 09/2022  – 03/2026  
 
CERTIFICATIONS  
 
Introduction  to Cybersecurity  & IoT 
Cisco  Networking  Academy  • 2023  
 
TECHNICAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES  
 
Management:  Agile/Scrum, SDLC, Backlog Prioritization, Risk Management, Resource  Planning, Project Planning.  
Tools:  Jira, Trello, Confluence, GitLab, GitHub, Slack, Zoom, MS Teams.  
Analysis & Design:  Technical Writing, BPMN, Miro, Lucidchart, User Research.  
Tech Stack (Architecture Knowledge):  React, Node.js, SQL (Postgres, MongoDB), Docker, REST API, Unreal Engine 5, C++, C#,  JS. 
English: Proficient (B2) | Polish: Proficient (B2) | Ukrainian/Russian: Native
